ORIGIN Atelier — sources

GSAP: https://gsap.com — license included.
Lenis: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis — MIT.

Diamond shader adapted from pmndrs/drei MeshRefractionMaterial by N8Programs — MIT, license included.

Downloaded design references (kept in workspace work/references):
https://github.com/codrops/RotatingOnScrollAnimations — MIT
https://github.com/codrops/ScrollTextMotion — MIT
Patterns studied: scroll-linked transformation, reduced motion, timeline-driven typography. The jewelry models, narrative, scene direction and page layout are original project work.

Editorial image generated with built-in ImageGen.
